result.analyst_notes: Corporate and aspirational, using first-person plural we throughout. Responsible growth is the headline frame, with growth stated as absolute and resolute, while clients are listed first. Community and employees appear as tenet elements. Legal disclaimers note that company goals are aspirational, not guarantees. Wording is largely abstract, with no environmental or safety commitments.
